description: A luxurious outdoor pool terrace photographed at low eye level, looking along the edge of a rectangular infinity-style pool at golden hour. The scene exudes resort-level minimalism — the terrace surface is a continuous expanse of large-format cream limestone pavers, polished smooth, and the pool edge is a clean geometric coping in matching creamy stone. A row of four low-slung teak sun loungers lines the left side of the pool deck, each dressed in thick off-white cushions and square linen throw pillows, with a neatly rolled beige terry towel placed at one end. A warm amber glow washes softly across the terrace surface and the lounger decks from low spherical light sources positioned at the pool edge, creating a rhythm of gentle warm pools spaced evenly along the coping. Each glow reflects as soft golden shimmering light on the still pool water surface below. The sky at the horizon is a breathtaking gradient of peach, soft coral, dusty rose, and pale grey — a late sunset sky framing a distant treeline of dark silhouetted Mediterranean vegetation. A large architectural column partially frames the upper left of the scene, and a tall potted tropical plant — possibly a bird of paradise or palm — is visible in the upper left corner against the warm sky. The palette is warm sunset tones, creamy stone, pale linen, and glass-still reflective water. The mood is serene, quietly luxurious, and romantic. Camera is at a low angle, approximately 2 feet off the ground, with a normal-to-slight telephoto lens looking along the pool coping with slight depth compression that stages the receding spheres beautifully.
